$$

{{field-1}}" :question/worked-solution "First, we express $y={e}^{4-5x}$ as the composite function

$$
y={e}^{u},\,u=4-5x.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}={e}^{u},\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-5.
$$

We now apply the chain rule, and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & ={e}^{u}\cdot (-5) \\  & =-5{e}^{u} \\  & =-5{e}^{4-5x}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, using the sum rule of differentiation, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{5}-{e}^{4-5x}) \\  & =5{x}^{4}-(-5{e}^{4-5x}) \\  & =5({x}^{4}+{e}^{4-5x}).\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["05118342-1d20-597e-be23-0e46a68395ca"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "e5884aa2-d5ab-5f93-8897-89214c01b41a" :answer/id #uuid "e5884aa2-d5ab-5f93-8897-89214c01b41a" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "4 e^{4 x - 6} + 2" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "0222a237-315c-536e-ad55-3c45f766115e" :answer-field/id #uuid "0222a237-315c-536e-ad55-3c45f766115e" :answer-field/key "field-1" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank :answer-field/choices ["e5884aa2-d5ab-5f93-8897-89214c01b41a"] :answer-field/correct "e5884aa2-d5ab-5f93-8897-89214c01b41a" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "46c70445-c7fa-5e96-b9db-24423c65d9d2" :question/id #uuid "46c70445-c7fa-5e96-b9db-24423c65d9d2" :question/problem "Calculate ${f}^{′}(x)$ if $f(x)=2x+{e}^{4x-6}.$

{{field-1}}" :question/worked-solution "First, we express $y={e}^{4x-6}$ as the composite function

$$
y={e}^{u},\,u=4x-6.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}={e}^{u},\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=4.
$$

We now apply the chain rule and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & ={e}^{u}\cdot 4 \\  & =4{e}^{u} \\  & =4{e}^{4x-6}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, using the sum rule of differentiation, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2x+{e}^{4x-6}) \\  & =2+4{e}^{4x-6} \\  & =4{e}^{4x-6}+2.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["0222a237-315c-536e-ad55-3c45f766115e"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "bffd7f70-58d6-5df1-9b3d-3f23c0d090b6" :answer/id #uuid "bffd7f70-58d6-5df1-9b3d-3f23c0d090b6" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y=- 12 e x - 3 + 20 e" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "97abff75-225b-5630-aa11-86faced36582" :answer/id #uuid "97abff75-225b-5630-aa11-86faced36582" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y=12 e \left(x - 2\right) - 4 e - 3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "d3230802-1784-5568-9bac-fcc769b517fc" :answer/id #uuid "d3230802-1784-5568-9bac-fcc769b517fc" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y=- 12 e \left(x - 2\right) - 4 e" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "e5850b7d-6ef6-55a7-b9dc-7cf2a4da7531" :answer/id #uuid "e5850b7d-6ef6-55a7-b9dc-7cf2a4da7531" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y=- 4 e \left(x - 2\right) - 4 e - 3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "4401eafb-fa33-5c95-b049-85b630f2f47d" :answer/id #uuid "4401eafb-fa33-5c95-b049-85b630f2f47d" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y=- 12 e x - 4 e - 3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c0fece4a-a8bb-548d-abc6-f90d6ed2350c" :answer-field/id #uuid "c0fece4a-a8bb-548d-abc6-f90d6ed2350c" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["bffd7f70-58d6-5df1-9b3d-3f23c0d090b6" "97abff75-225b-5630-aa11-86faced36582" "d3230802-1784-5568-9bac-fcc769b517fc" "e5850b7d-6ef6-55a7-b9dc-7cf2a4da7531" "4401eafb-fa33-5c95-b049-85b630f2f47d"] :answer-field/correct "bffd7f70-58d6-5df1-9b3d-3f23c0d090b6" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "c6bcf79b-eac1-52f9-ad10-1945c83effb0" :question/id #uuid "c6bcf79b-eac1-52f9-ad10-1945c83effb0" :question/problem "Find the equation of the tangent to the curve $y=-4{e}^{3x-5}-3$ at the point where $x=2.$" :question/worked-solution "First, we express $y$ as the composite function

$$
y=-4{e}^{u}-3,\,u=3x-5.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}=-4{e}^{u},\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=3.
$$

We now apply the chain rule, and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & =-4{e}^{u}\cdot 3 \\  & =-12{e}^{u} \\  & =-12{e}^{3x-5}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to find the slope of the tangent to the curve at $x=2$, we have to evaluate $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ at that point as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}{|}_{x=2} & =-12{e}^{3x-5}{|}_{x=2} \\ & =-12{e}^{(3)(2)-5} \\ & =- 12 e.\end{aligned}
$$

Also, the $y$-value of the point on the curve where $x=x_1=2$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}y_1 & =(-4{e}^{3x-5}-3){|}_{x=2} \\ & =-4{e}^{(3)(2)-5}-3 \\ & =- 4 e - 3.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we find the equation of the tangent at that point:

$$
\begin{aligned}y-y_1 & =m(x-x_1) \\ y-(- 4 e - 3) & =(- 12 e)(x-(2)) \\ y-(- 4 e - 3) & =- 12 e x-(- 24 e) \\ y & =- 12 e x - 3 + 20 e.\end{aligned}
